The authors developed and piloted a simulation-based course to train AI-assisted SDM to final-year medical students preparing for residency. Conducted between June and October 2023, the course combined online prelearning with onsite simulations using clinically approved AI tools (Lunit INSIGHT CXR, version 3.1.4.1 and MMG, version 1.1.4.3; Lunit Inc., Seoul, South Korea; used November 16 and 27, 2023).
